explanation: The value is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and at D1 it is high only when the previous trial ended in S2 without a reward: about 10 (7-10) if the agent had chosen a1 and reached S2 by a rare transition, and only about 2 if it had chosen a2 and reached S2 commonly, rising to roughly 4-7 when several unrewarded a2 trials come in a row. D1 is 0 after any rewarded trial and after any unrewarded trial that ended in S1, whatever the agent chose.
